releaseNotes:
## Fixes
- **Weekly overview** loads again after a crash caused by the time-format change on the mobile week view
- Clock times across the app follow Settings > General **Time format** (24h / 12h), including conference lists, booking import preview, guest-list times, and backup schedule labels
- Meal-plan coffee labels no longer say "Coffee AM/PM" (morning/afternoon coffee instead)

## Notes
- Native time pickers may still follow the operating system
- Stored database times are unchanged
